battle.name: 高越原之戰
battle.brief: 開皇三年五月十四日，隋文帝詔秦州總管竇榮率步騎三萬北擊突闌渾，兩軍戰於河西走廊西北的高越原沙地。此地乾枯無水，隋軍只能飲馬血解渴。此役靠騎射、馬力與冷兵器斬將分出勝負，未見折腰直刃之外的新裝備；卡面月牙劍那種外彎單刃、砍下不須回抽的劈砍邏輯，正是史萬歲一擊斬將的刀法所在。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 開皇三年北擊突闌渾，是隋朝與鐵勒系部族聯盟在河西走廊西北的一場邊境戰役。隋方由秦州總管竇榮掛帥，率步騎三萬自秦州、涼州一帶出發，主力是重裝步卒與輕騎混合的軍團，後方由涼州、武威等郡供應糧秣與補充馬匹，兵員調度歸尚書省與兵部軍令，隋文帝楊堅自長安遙領。突闌渾一方以阿波可汗為首，屬鐵勒諸部的聯盟，逐水草而居，控弦為業，全軍以騎兵為骨架，營地散在沙碛地帶，遇戰則以游騎擾敵、覓隙衝陣，敗後各自散歸本帳。兩軍的指揮體系都極度依賴戰馬與首領的號令：隋軍靠漢式軍令與嚴整的步兵核心維持縱隊，突闌渾則靠可汗與部落長老分掌節制權。整場衝突規模屬戰役級而非大會戰，卻牽動隋朝對河西走廊與西域通道的整體部署。
countriesEn: The Battle of Gao-yue Plain was a frontier engagement fought in the far north-west of the Hexi Corridor between the Sui dynasty and a confederation of Tiele tribes. On the Sui side, Dou Rong, commander of Qin Prefecture, held supreme command over a mixed force of foot and cavalry numbering thirty thousand, mustered from Qin, Liang and the western commanderies; the rear was supplied with grain, fodder and replacement mounts by the commanderies of Liang and Wuwei, and the whole operation was ordered by the central administration, with Emperor Wen of Sui himself directing the campaign from Chang'an. The Tuwwan side was led by the khagan Abobo and formed a loose alliance of Tiele bands who moved with the pastures, lived on herding and hunting, and fought as mounted archers; their camps were scattered across the sand flats, and in battle they would swarm the enemy with light horse, probe for gaps and strike, then disperse back to their own tents after defeat. Both command structures rested on horses and on personal authority: the Sui army was held together by Chinese-style orders and a disciplined infantry core, while the Tuwwan confederation split its command between the khagan and tribal elders. In scale this was a campaign battle rather than a set-piece general engagement, yet it shaped the Sui court's whole posture along the Hexi Corridor and the western trade routes.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這一役的決策者：開皇三年春，他下詔討伐犯邊的突闌渾，點竇榮為主將，給足三萬步騎的兵員與自行調用的糧秣，戰後又接納突闌渾的求和與入朝貢使，把一場邊戰轉成朝貢關係。竇榮是秦州總管，出身關隴軍事家族，臨危受命率兵深入沙碛，在無水之地靠意志撐住全軍，並由他決定在雨勢轉好、士氣回升時合擊，是全役最關鍵的一次決斷。真正扭轉戰局的是名將史萬歲，他自請出戰，一合斬殺阿波可汗所遣的挑戰騎將，隨即乘勢驅騎追擊，斬其眾千餘，逼得對方再不敢接戰。突闌渾首領阿波可汗統兵來犯，卻在騎將被斬、士氣受挫之後轉為請和。另有一人不出刀而在幕後推局：長孫晟奉命出使突闌渾，離間阿波可汗與達頭可汗之間的關係，把對方內部的裂痕說成隋朝可乘之機，令突闌渾最終不敢與隋軍死戰到底。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui was the man who set the whole thing in motion: in the spring of Kaihuang 3 (583) he ordered the punitive expedition against the Tuwwan, appointed Dou Rong commander-in-chief, granted him thirty thousand foot and cavalry together with authority to draw on his own supply trains, and after the fighting received the Tuwwan envoys who came to court with tribute, turning a frontier clash into a tributary relationship. Dou Rong, commander of Qin Prefecture, came from a family of Guanzhong military men and was handed the assignment when the army had to march deep into the desert; his refusal to turn back with an exhausted force, and his decision to strike as soon as the weather broke, were the decisive turns of the engagement. The man who actually broke the enemy was the famous general Shi Wansui, who volunteered for the single combat, cut down the mounted challenger sent by Abobo in one stroke, and then rode hard after the khagan himself, killing more than a thousand of the enemy in the pursuit, after which the Tuwwan no longer dared to accept battle. Abobo, khagan of the Tuwwan, had come out to invade and ended the campaign begging for terms. One more figure moved the game without drawing a blade: Zhangsun Sheng, sent as envoy to the Tuwwan, worked on the rift between Abobo and the khagan Datou, so that the enemy camp came to believe its own alliance was near collapse and chose negotiation over a fight to the death.
kits: 這張卡面上的兵器是埃及月牙劍，約公元前一千五百年已在埃及人手裡成形：單刃、外彎、刃口朝內，砍進去不必回抽拔刃，比直刃劍更早出現在尼羅河文明的戰陣上。在開皇三年的河西，它只能放在「同類兵器譜系的源頭」這個位置上，而不能當成戰場上的實配：史籍記載此役交戰雙方用的是中原與草原常見的環首刀、長柄槊、角弓與鳴鏑、箭袋、皮甲與少量鐵甲，沒有任何一條記載提到月牙劍或它的仿製品出現在高越原。但它所代表的戰鬥邏輯正落在史萬歲那一擊上——兩騎相接的一瞬間，外彎單刃只要順勢斜拉就能切開對手，不必像直刃那樣砍完再往回拔，這正是乘馬衝陣時最省時間的砍擊方式；史萬歲斬騎將、追斬千餘，靠的就是速度、角度與手中那一柄短兵。此外此役真正的裝備重點還在馬具與水源：沙地乾枯無水，隋軍只能飲馬血解渴，戰馬、鞍韂與隨軍水囊的數量，實際上決定了三萬人馬能在沙灘上撐多久。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a form already in Egyptian hands by about 1500 BCE: single-edged, curved outward, with the cutting edge on the inside, so that a stroke does not have to be pulled back out of the target, and older in use among the people of the Nile than the straight sword. At Gao-yue Plain in 583 it can only be placed as the ancestor of a family of blades, not as a piece of equipment actually carried into the field. What the records show being used on both sides are the ordinary fittings of Chinese and steppe warfare: ring-pommel sabres, long spears, composite bows with whistling arrows, quivers, leather armour with a little iron protection, saddles and water flasks. No source mentions a khopesh or a copy of one at Gao-yue. What the card does represent is the logic of the blow that Shi Wansui landed. When two mounted men close, a blade curved outward can be drawn along the target with the arm's motion, whereas a straight edge has to be pulled back out of the cut; that is the fastest possible stroke in a charge, and the general who cut down a rider and then killed more than a thousand men in the pursuit was relying on speed, angle and one short sword in his hand. The real weight of equipment in this battle lay elsewhere, in horse harness and in water: the sand flats were dry and waterless, the Sui troops had to drink the blood of their own horses, and the number of mounts, saddles and water skins in the column decided how long thirty thousand men could stay in the field.
tactics: 竇榮把三萬步騎帶到高越原時，撞上的是一條乾枯無水的沙地帶，沙中幾無水源，連人畜的飲水都難以維持。隋軍在缺水下大量減員，據史載軍中以馬血解渴，死者約十之二三，軍心幾近崩潰。就在全軍最脆弱的時候，天降一場雨，士氣為之一振，竇榮趁著氣候轉好與士氣回升，揮軍合擊，把騎兵的正面衝力壓向阿波可汗的中軍，多次擊退其前鋒，把原本各自為戰的散兵壓成可以切割的密集隊形。對方轉而依賴草原式的單騎挑戰：阿波可汗遣一員騎將出陣叫陣，隋軍以史萬歲應戰，他一擊斬將，又乘勢驅騎追擊阿波可汗本人，斬其眾千餘，擴散了戰果，迫使對方收攏、不再接戰，最後請和退兵。整場戰術可概括成三段：先以步騎混編的方陣頂住騎兵衝撞，再以單挑斬將摧掉對方的指揮節點，最後以騎兵追擊放大勝果。戰後隋朝沒有乘勝深入攻擊，而是轉用外交手段，由長孫晟出使離間，令突闌渾與達頭可汗互相猜忌，使對手在軍事失利後更傾向求和而非死戰。
tacticsEn: When Dou Rong brought his thirty thousand to Gao-yue he found a belt of sand with no water in it, dry enough that neither men nor animals could find anything to drink. The Sui army melted away: to their horror they had to drink the blood of their own horses, and the sources put the death toll at something like two or three men in every ten, with the rank and file close to breaking. At the moment when the force was weakest the weather broke and rain fell, the spirit of the troops lifted, and Dou Rong took advantage of both the freshened conditions and the recovered morale to launch a combined assault, driving the weight of his mounted line into the centre of Abobo's army and beating back the enemy vanguard more than once, compressing scattered mounted bands into a mass that could be cut apart. The Tuwwan then fell back on the steppe custom of single combat: the khagan sent out one mounted challenger, Shi Wansui accepted, cut him down at the first stroke, and rode after Abobo himself, killing some thousand of his men, which told the enemy the battle was lost; they closed up, refused further engagement, and finally asked for terms. The pattern of the action is in three movements: a mixed infantry and cavalry square to absorb the charge, a single combat to remove the enemy's command node, and a mounted pursuit to enlarge the result. Afterwards the Sui did not press the victory into a general pursuit; Zhangsun Sheng was sent to exploit the divisions among the enemy, feeding the khagan's doubts about his partner until a defeated enemy chose negotiation over annihilation.
data: 可考的數字集中在兵員、日期與損耗三方面。開皇三年四月，隋朝全面反擊突闌渾；五月十四日，竇榮所部與突闌渾在河西走廊西北的高越原沙地正式交鋒；五月二十五日，雙方立約各遣一名勇士單獨決鬥，這場比試由史萬歲代表隋方。隋軍出動兵力為步騎三萬，由秦州總管竇榮率領。缺水造成的代價記錄為「十之二三」，即軍中因飲水不足而死亡的比率約在十分之二到十分之三之間，這是全軍減員的主要來源，而非戰鬥損失。史萬歲一役斬殺突闌渾眾千餘人，是此戰有明確數字的斬獲。戰場位置在高越原，即今甘肅省民勤縣西北的沙碛地帶，距隋朝涼州、武威等州郡治所甚遠，遠程供應全靠隨軍輜重與沿途驛傳。時間上，整場戰事集中在開皇三年五月的前十餘日，其後隨著突闌渾遣使入朝貢方物而轉入外交處理。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on concern strength, dates and losses. In the fourth month of Kaihuang 3 (583) the Sui launched a general offensive against the Tuwwan; on the fourteenth day of the fifth month Dou Rong's army met the Tuwwan on the sand flats of Gao-yue in the north-west of the Hexi Corridor; on the twenty-fifth day of the same month the two sides agreed that each would send a single warrior to a personal duel, and the Sui representative in that bout was Shi Wansui. The Sui force that marched out was thirty thousand foot and cavalry under Dou Rong, commander of Qin Prefecture. The cost of thirst is recorded as two or three in ten, that is, roughly a fifth to a third of the command died for want of water, which was the main source of attrition rather than combat losses. Shi Wansui's own count for the day is more than a thousand of the enemy killed. The battlefield lay at Gao-yue, in the sand country north-west of present-day Minqin County in Gansu, a long way from the seats of the Sui commanderies of Liang and Wuwei, so that all supply came with the baggage train and the relay posts along the route. In time the whole affair was compressed into the first two weeks or so of the fifth month of 583, after which the Tuwwan sent an embassy to court with tribute and the matter passed into diplomacy.
cause: 起事在邊境。開皇三年之前，鐵勒系的突闌渾部在河西走廊一帶日益坐大，屢次入犯隋朝邊郡，掠取人口與牲畜，與北方的頡利可汗相互爭雄，把河西的邊防線拉成一個不斷收緊的壓力點。隋文帝楊堅在開皇年間先平北、再圖南，北方局勢一旦稍定，視線就轉回西北通道的安全；開皇三年春，他下詔以秦州總管竇榮為主將，率步騎三萬討伐突闌渾，兵分數路深入沙碛，目標不只是解邊患，也是在西域通道上建立可持續的震懾。推動這場戰役的還有兩個結構性因素：其一，隋朝剛完成的均田、租調與戶口整理，使三萬大軍的糧秣能靠郡縣調度支應；其二，自西魏、北周以來關隴將門掌握騎兵統率的傳統，竇榮、史萬歲一系正好承接這套以騎兵為骨幹、步卒為殿衛的用兵法。外交層面上，隋朝也清楚光靠武力壓不住沙地上的部落聯盟，戰前已派長孫晟前往交涉，把開打與交談並行。
causeEn: The war began on the frontier. Before 583 the Tiele Tuwwan had grown strong in the Hexi Corridor, raiding Sui border commanderies for people and cattle and competing with the khagan of the eastern Turks, which turned the western line of the empire into a pressure point that never relaxed. Emperor Wen of Sui, having first settled the north and then turned his attention south, treated the security of the north-western corridor as the unfinished business of the moment; in the spring of Kaihuang 3 he issued the order that sent Dou Rong with thirty thousand foot and cavalry against the Tuwwan, pushing several columns deep into the desert in order to relieve the border and, at the same time, to establish a deterrent the western trade routes would respect. Two structural reasons made such a campaign possible. First, the recent completion of the equal-field, grain-tax and household registration reforms of the Sui allowed the grain for thirty thousand men to be drawn from the commanderies; second, the tradition of the Guanzhong military houses, who had commanded the cavalry of the western regimes since Western Wei and Northern Zhou, handed the job to Dou Rong and Shi Wansui with a ready doctrine of mounted core and infantry support. Diplomacy ran alongside the fighting: the court knew that no army could hold the tribes of the sand permanently, and Zhangsun Sheng was sent ahead to parley even as the columns advanced.
impact: 高越原一役的直接後果，是突闌渾在軍事失利與內部裂痕的雙重壓力下轉向求和，遣使入朝貢方物，隋朝也樂得用封爵與互市把這支部族收進西域秩序，而不是把三萬大軍長久押在沙地上。對隋朝而言，這一仗確立了河西走廊西段的邊防主導權：涼州、武威一線從此有相當長時間不必面對西面的部族壓力，隋朝得以把主要精力轉往北面的突厥戰場與南面的平陳準備，第二年高平之戰破尉遲迥、再往後大舉南下滅陳，都建立在西線暫時安定的基礎上。對草原世界而言，突闌渾並未被消滅，阿波可汗之後其部仍在西域與河西一帶活動，隋亡之後更成為唐初西北邊患的一部分，後來隨著草原帝國的重組被併入更大的突厥系政權。武器史的層面也值得留意：此役再次顯示冷兵器時代近戰往往決定在單兵斬將的一瞬，月牙劍所代表的「單刃外彎、砍下不抽」一路，至今仍可在後世騎戰刀法中找到痕跡；而真正在河西沙地決定勝負的，則是馬匹、弓箭，以及能在缺水環境中維持半個月的紀律。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of Gao-yue was that the Tuwwan, squeezed by defeat on the field and by suspicion inside their own camp, turned to terms: envoys came to court with tribute, and the Sui were glad to take the tribe into the western order through titles and trade rather than keep thirty thousand men on the sand. For the Sui the victory settled who held the western end of the Hexi Corridor; the line of Liang and Wuwei was spared for a considerable time, and the attention of the court could go to the north against the Turks and to the south towards the conquest of Chen. The campaigns of the following years, the defeat of Yuwen Jiong at Gaoping and the destruction of the Chen dynasty, all rest on that western calm. For the steppe the Tuwwan were not erased: after Abobo the tribe remained active in the western regions, became one of the north-western problems of the early Tang, and was later swallowed by the larger Turkic power as the steppe reorganised. The arms history of the affair is also worth a line: this battle again showed that close fighting is decided in the fraction of a second when one man cuts down another, and the khopesh idea, a single outward-curved edge that is not drawn back after the blow, survives to this day in later cavalry swordsmanship; but what actually decided the business on the sand flats of Gansu was the horse, the bow, and the discipline that held a column together for half a month without water.
result: 結果是隋軍完勝。突闌渾方面在五月十四日高越原交鋒中被竇榮乘勢合擊，多次受挫，又在五月二十五日的單獨決鬥中折損挑戰騎將、被史萬歲追斬千餘人，士氣崩解，遂不敢再戰，轉而請和退兵；其首領阿波可汗本人在亂軍中未被擒斬，隨大軍退回部帳，部眾星散於沙碛與草場之間。隋軍方面，竇榮所部雖因缺水死傷慘重，仍然全軍凱旋，沒有被敵人騎兵拖入消耗戰。史萬歲因斬將追殺之功在隋朝軍界嶄露頭角，同年又在高平之戰中破尉遲迥，名字被寫進隋書的將列；長孫晟的離間則令突闌渾與達頭可汗之間互相防備，隋朝不必再為這個部族多費一支大軍。這場事件沒有以任何一方的徹底覆滅收場：阿波可汗仍是突闌渾之長，突闌渾仍是西域一支不可忽視的力量，河西的邊患只是被推遲而不是被解決。歷史給高越原留下的定位，是隋朝在統一北方之後、走向全面南征之前的一次西北邊境經營。
resultEn: The result was a Sui victory. The Tuwwan were checked repeatedly at the engagement of Gao-yue on the fourteenth day of the fifth month, lost their mounted challenger in the duel agreed on the twenty-fifth, and were cut down and pursued by Shi Wansui to the loss of more than a thousand men; their nerve broke, they would not fight again, and they asked for peace and withdrew. Abobo himself was neither taken nor killed in the fighting; he rode back to his tents with the remnant of his following, which scattered across the sands and pastures. The Sui army under Dou Rong came back whole, having suffered heavy losses of its own to thirst but never having been drawn into a war of attrition by the enemy horse. Shi Wansui's performance, one stroke against a rider and a long pursuit, made his name in the Sui military, and he added the victory at Gaoping in the same year, entering the biographies of the Sui history; Zhangsun Sheng's work set the Tuwwan and the khagan of Datou against one another and saved the court another campaign. Nothing was settled to the last: Abobo remained khan, the Tuwwan remained a power in the western regions, and the frontier problem of the corridor was postponed rather than solved. History kept Gao-yue as a piece of north-west frontier management, taken by the Sui after they had settled the north and before the great march south.
